senses.exampleEn: At the tops of the balusters are carved southern fruits: peach, star-fruit (carambola), papaya, lychee, and so on — symbolic sacrificial offerings of the choicest Lingnan fruits to the Chen ancestors.
senses.exampleZh: 栏杆顶端雕着南方水果：桃、杨桃、木瓜、荔枝等——象征把最精美的岭南佳果献给陈氏祖先。

senses.zh: n. 雕刻品（carving的复数）
senses.enDef: n a sculpture created by removing material (as wood or ivory or stone) in order to create a desired shape
senses.exampleEn: From roof to floor, inside and out — columns, eaves, ridges, stairs, doors and windows — you will find stone carvings, brick carvings, lime sculptures, ceramic figurines, wood carvings, and iron-cast artistic pieces.
senses.exampleZh: 从屋顶到地面，里里外外——柱、檐、脊、阶、门窗——都能见到石雕、砖雕、灰塑、陶塑、木雕和铸铁艺术品。

senses.zh: n. 雕刻品（carving的复数）
senses.enDef: n removing parts from hard material to create a desired pattern or shape

senses.zh: n. 雕刻品（carving的复数）
senses.enDef: n creating figures or designs in three dimensions

senses.zh: n. 雕刻品（carving的复数）
senses.enDef: v form by carving

senses.zh: n. 雕刻品（carving的复数）
senses.enDef: v engrave or cut by chipping away at a surface

senses.zh: n. 雕刻品（carving的复数）
senses.enDef: v cut to pieces

senses.zh: n. 演员阵容, 投掷, 铸件, 预测, 特性
senses.enDef: n. the actors in a play
senses.exampleEn: Records say imperial seals were white jade with a tiger-shaped handle; but Zhao Mo’s seal is gold with a dragon handle, cast in Nanyue, and used in his lifetime.
senses.exampleZh: 文献记载帝印应为白玉虎钮；但赵眜这枚是龙钮金印，在南越铸造，生前使用。

senses.zh: vt. 投, 掷, 抛, 脱落, 铸, 使弯曲, 计算
senses.enDef: n. the distinctive form in which a thing is made

senses.zh: vi. 投, 计算, 浇铸成型
senses.enDef: n. bandage consisting of a firm covering (often made of plaster of Paris) that immobilizes broken bones while they heal

senses.zh: n. 演员阵容, 投掷, 铸件, 预测, 特性
senses.enDef: n. object formed by a mold

senses.zh: n. 捕捉, 陷阱, 捕捉之物, 抓, 拉手
senses.enDef: n. a drawback or difficulty that is not readily evident
senses.exampleEn: The earliest were legendary Shentu and Yulei, said to catch ghosts and protect the house.
senses.exampleZh: 最早的门神是传说中的神荼和郁垒，据说能捉鬼护宅。

senses.zh: vt. 捕捉, 赶上, 感染, 听清楚
senses.enDef: n. the quantity that was caught

senses.zh: vi. 抓住, 燃着
senses.enDef: n. a person regarded as a good matrimonial prospect

senses.zh: n. 捕捉, 陷阱, 捕捉之物, 抓, 拉手
senses.enDef: n. anything that is caught (especially if it is worth catching)

senses.zh: n. 原因, 目标
senses.enDef: n. events that provide the generative force that is the origin of something
senses.exampleEn: The chickens stand for the present generations; the banana’s big leaves (da ye) sound like “great property” or “great undertaking,” so they suggest the wealth and cause created by past generations.
senses.exampleZh: 鸡群代表今人；芭蕉的“大叶”与“大业”谐音，暗示先辈开创的财富与事业。

senses.zh: vt. 引起, 使产生, 使遭受
senses.enDef: n. a justification for something existing or happening

senses.zh: n. 原因, 目标
senses.enDef: v. give rise to; cause to happen or occur, not always intentionally

senses.zh: a. 中央的, 重要的
senses.enDef: n. a workplace that serves as a telecommunications facility where lines from telephones can be connected together to permit communication
senses.exampleEn: Burying the living with dead sovereigns had prevailed in Central China in the Shang and Zhou dynasties (1766–770 BC), but was largely abolished in the Han Dynasty (206 BC–AD 220).
senses.exampleZh: 活人殉葬在商周时期（公元前一七六六至七七〇年）曾盛行于中原，到汉代（公元前二〇六至公元二二〇年）已基本废除。

senses.zh: [医] 中央的, 中心的, 中枢的
senses.enDef: a. in or near a center or constituting a center; the inner area

senses.zh: a. 陶瓷的
senses.enDef: n. an artifact made of hard brittle material produced from nonmetallic minerals by firing at high temperatures
senses.exampleEn: From roof to floor, inside and out — columns, eaves, ridges, stairs, doors and windows — you will find stone carvings, brick carvings, lime sculptures, ceramic figurines, wood carvings, and iron-cast artistic pieces.
senses.exampleZh: 从屋顶到地面，里里外外——柱、檐、脊、阶、门窗——都能见到石雕、砖雕、灰塑、陶塑、木雕和铸铁艺术品。

senses.zh: n. 陶瓷制品
senses.enDef: a. of or relating to or made from a ceramic

senses.zh: n. 链, 枷锁, 束缚
senses.enDef: n. a series of things depending on each other as if linked together
senses.exampleEn: Hold this chain: Zhao Tuo’s kingdom → Zhao Mo the second king → 1983 Elephant Hill → fifteen sacrificial persons → gold dragon-handle seal + nine jade seals (three on the body) → silk jade garment → bronze treasures → Guangzhou’s origins.
senses.exampleZh: 请记住这条链条：赵佗建国 → 第二代王赵眜 → 一九八三年象岗 → 十五人殉葬 → 龙钮金印加九枚玉印（三枚在身上） → 丝缕玉衣 → 青铜珍宝 → 广州起源。

senses.zh: vt. 用铁练锁住, 束缚, 囚禁
senses.enDef: n. (chemistry) a series of linked atoms (generally in an organic molecule)

senses.zh: n. 链, 枷锁, 束缚
senses.enDef: n. a series of (usually metal) rings or links fitted into one another to make a flexible ligament

senses.zh: n. 链, 枷锁, 束缚
senses.enDef: n. (business) a number of similar establishments (stores or restaurants or banks or hotels or theaters) under one ownership

senses.zh: n. 室, 房间, 枪膛
senses.enDef: n. a natural or artificial enclosed space
senses.exampleEn: In the tomb, fifteen persons were found buried alive with the dead: one in the front chamber — a “Jing Xiang Ling,” perhaps a eunuch; one in the outer coffin, probably a cart-driver.
senses.exampleZh: 墓中发现十五人为殉葬：前室一人——“景巷令”，或许是宦官；外棺一人，可能是车夫。

senses.zh: vt. 装(弹药), 把...关在室内
senses.enDef: n. an enclosed volume in the body

senses.zh: a. 室内的
senses.enDef: n. a room where a judge transacts business

senses.zh: n. 室, 房间, 枪膛
senses.enDef: n. a deliberative or legislative or administrative or judicial assembly

senses.zh: n. 钱伯斯（姓氏）
senses.enDef: n. English architect (1723-1796)
senses.exampleEn: It covers about 100 square meters, is built of 750 blocks of red sandstone, and is divided into front and rear sections with seven chambers in all.
senses.exampleZh: 墓室约一百平方米，用七百五十块红砂岩石砌成，分前后两部分，共七个墓室。

senses.zh: n. 美洲变色蜥蜴, 善变的人
senses.enDef: n. a changeable or inconstant person
senses.exampleEn: It is called “Bian Se Long” — the chameleon — because its color changes with the seasons: light green in spring, dark green in summer, yellowish green in autumn, and brownish yellow in winter.
senses.exampleZh: 它叫“变色龙”——颜色随季节而变：春浅绿、夏深绿、秋黄绿、冬棕黄。

senses.zh: [医] 避役属(蜴蜥之一属)
senses.enDef: n. lizard of Africa and Madagascar able to change skin color and having a projectile tongue

senses.zh: n. 青稞酒（等于chong）
senses.enDef: n the longest river of Asia; flows eastward from Tibet into the East China Sea near Shanghai
senses.exampleEn: The spot under excavation matched the position of Chang Le Gong in the Han palace at Chang’an — so was this Nanyue’s “Chang Le Gong”?
senses.exampleZh: 发掘位置与汉长安宫中的长乐宫位置相对应——那么这里会是南越的“长乐宫”吗？

senses.zh: n. 变化, 改变（change的复数）
senses.enDef: n an event that occurs when something passes from one state or phase to another
senses.exampleEn: It is called “Bian Se Long” — the chameleon — because its color changes with the seasons: light green in spring, dark green in summer, yellowish green in autumn, and brownish yellow in winter.
senses.exampleZh: 它叫“变色龙”——颜色随季节而变：春浅绿、夏深绿、秋黄绿、冬棕黄。

senses.zh: n. 变化, 改变（change的复数）
senses.enDef: n a relational difference between states; especially between states before and after some event

senses.zh: n. 变化, 改变（change的复数）
senses.enDef: n the action of changing something

senses.zh: n. 变化, 改变（change的复数）
senses.enDef: n the result of alteration or modification

senses.zh: n. 变化, 改变（change的复数）
senses.enDef: n the balance of money received when the amount you tender is greater than the amount due

senses.zh: n. 变化, 改变（change的复数）
senses.enDef: n a thing that is different

senses.zh: n. 个性, 字符, 人物, 性质, 品格, 资格
senses.enDef: n. the inherent complex of attributes that determines a persons moral and ethical actions and reactions
senses.exampleEn: Notice an inverted character for happiness / good fortune (fu), often on the reverse of a wood-carving.
senses.exampleZh: 请注意一个倒着的“福”字，常出现在木雕背面。

senses.zh: [计] 字符
senses.enDef: n. an actor's portrayal of someone in a play

senses.zh: n. 个性, 字符, 人物, 性质, 品格, 资格
senses.enDef: n. a person of a specified kind (usually with many eccentricities)

senses.zh: n. 个性, 字符, 人物, 性质, 品格, 资格
senses.enDef: n. good repute

senses.zh: n. 特性；人物角色（character复数）
senses.enDef: n an imaginary person represented in a work of fiction (play or film or story)
senses.exampleEn: On the tall arched gate are the characters “立园.”
senses.exampleZh: 高大的拱门上写着“立园”二字。

senses.zh: n. 特性；人物角色（character复数）
senses.enDef: n a characteristic property that defines the apparent individual nature of something

senses.zh: n. 特性；人物角色（character复数）
senses.enDef: n the inherent complex of attributes that determines a persons moral and ethical actions and reactions

senses.zh: n. 特性；人物角色（character复数）
senses.enDef: n an actor's portrayal of someone in a play

senses.zh: n. 特性；人物角色（character复数）
senses.enDef: n a person of a specified kind (usually with many eccentricities)

senses.zh: n. 特性；人物角色（character复数）
senses.enDef: n good repute

senses.zh: n. 化学药品
senses.enDef: n. material produced by or used in a reaction involving changes in atoms or molecules
senses.exampleEn: One silver box, by shape and ornament so different from traditional Chinese silverware, and by chemical analysis of the pills inside, is believed to be a product from overseas Persia, with contents likely a kind of Arabian medicine — evidence of early maritime contact.
senses.exampleZh: 有一件银盒，从造型和纹饰看与中国传统银器截然不同；对盒内丸药的化学分析显示，它很可能来自海外波斯，内容物似为一种阿拉伯药物——这是早期海上交往的证据。

senses.zh: a. 化学的, 化学上用的
senses.enDef: a. relating to or used in chemistry

senses.zh: n. 化学药品
senses.enDef: a. of or made from or using substances produced by or used in reactions involving atomic or molecular changes

senses.zh: n. 陈
senses.enDef: n. wild goose having white adult plumage
senses.exampleEn: Today we visit the Chen Family Temple, also called the Chen Clan Academy — the “Pearl of Lingnan Artistic Architecture” in the heart of Guangzhou.
senses.exampleZh: 今天我们参观陈家祠，也称陈氏书院——广州城中心的“岭南建筑艺术明珠”。

senses.zh: n. 胸, 胸部, 衣柜, 箱子
senses.enDef: n. box with a lid; used for storage; usually large and sturdy
senses.exampleEn: It looks like a young girl lying down to sleep: from right to left, her head, neck, chest, and belly are clearly outlined.
senses.exampleZh: 它像一位少女躺着入睡：从右到左，头、颈、胸、腹轮廓清晰。

senses.zh: [医] 胸, 胸廓
senses.enDef: n. box with a lid; used for storage; usually large and sturdy

senses.zh: n. 鸡( chicken的复数形式 ); 鸡肉
senses.enDef: n. the flesh of a chicken used for food
senses.exampleEn: The chickens stand for the present generations; the banana’s big leaves (da ye) sound like “great property” or “great undertaking,” so they suggest the wealth and cause created by past generations.
senses.exampleZh: 鸡群代表今人；芭蕉的“大叶”与“大业”谐音，暗示先辈开创的财富与事业。

senses.zh: n. 鸡( chicken的复数形式 ); 鸡肉
senses.enDef: n. a domestic fowl bred for flesh or eggs; believed to have been developed from the red jungle fowl

senses.zh: n. 鸡( chicken的复数形式 ); 鸡肉
senses.enDef: n. a person who lacks confidence, is irresolute and wishy-washy

senses.zh: n. 雏鸡；小鸡（chick的复数形式）
senses.enDef: n young bird especially of domestic fowl
senses.exampleEn: Look at this picture: a hen and chicks foraging under a banana tree.
senses.exampleZh: 请看这幅图：母鸡带着小鸡在芭蕉树下觅食。

senses.zh: n. 雏鸡；小鸡（chick的复数形式）
senses.enDef: n informal terms for a (young) woman

senses.zh: n. 孩童时期
senses.enDef: n. the time of person's life when they are a child
senses.exampleEn: Childhood and resolve.
senses.exampleZh: 童年与立志。

senses.zh: [医] 儿童期
senses.enDef: n. the state of a child between infancy and adolescence

senses.zh: pl. 孩子, 孩子们
senses.enDef: n a young person of either sex
senses.exampleEn: This place served as a shrine for sacrifices to the common ancestors of the Chen families; as a venue for clannish activities on festive and other special occasions; and as a school for Chen children — hence “Chen Clan Academy.”
senses.exampleZh: 这里既是陈姓各房祭祀共同祖先的祠堂，也是节庆等特殊场合举行宗族活动的场所，还是陈氏子弟读书的学堂——所以叫“陈氏书院”。

senses.zh: pl. 孩子, 孩子们
senses.enDef: n a human offspring (son or daughter) of any age

senses.zh: pl. 孩子, 孩子们
senses.enDef: n an immature childish person

senses.zh: pl. 孩子, 孩子们
senses.enDef: n a member of a clan or tribe

senses.zh: n. 钟声, 钟, 和谐
senses.enDef: n. a percussion instrument consisting of a set of tuned bells that are struck with a hammer; used as an orchestral instrument
senses.exampleEn: Especially worth mentioning is a chime of bronzes called “Gou Diao”: eight pieces, cast with the epigraph “Made in the Official Conservatory in the Ninth Year of Emperor Wen,” showing they were made in Nanyue in 129 BC.
senses.exampleZh: 尤其值得一提的是一组青铜乐器“句鑃”Gou Diao：共八件，铸有铭文“文帝九年乐府工造”，说明它们于公元前一二九年在南越制成。

senses.zh: vi. 鸣, 奏出谐和的乐声, 和谐
senses.enDef: v. emit a sound

senses.zh: vt. 敲出和谐的声音, 打钟报时, 重复说
senses.enDef: n. a percussion instrument consisting of a set of tuned bells that are struck with a hammer; used as an orchestral instrument

senses.zh: n. 中国, 瓷器
senses.enDef: n. a communist nation that covers a vast territory in eastern Asia; the most populous country in the world
senses.exampleEn: In the family of Lingnan buildings, it stands among the great ritual / institutional landmarks — alongside places like the Temple of the South China Sea God and Foshan Ancestral Temple — while Kaiping’s watchtowers represent world-heritage vernacular fortresses.
senses.exampleZh: 在岭南建筑大家族里，它与南海神庙、佛山祖庙等并列，属于重要的礼制建筑；而开平碉楼则代表世界遗产级的民间堡垒建筑。

senses.zh: a. 中国的
senses.enDef: n. high quality porcelain originally made only in China

senses.zh: n. 中文, 中国话, 中国人
senses.enDef: n. any of the Sino-Tibetan languages spoken in China; regarded as dialects of a single language (even though they are mutually unintelligible) because they share an ideographic writing system
senses.exampleEn: A bird, a deer, a bee, and a monkey appear together: their Chinese names are homonyms for titles of nobility, official salary, and the granting of noble ranks — a wish that Chen descendants would win scholarly honors and high office.
senses.exampleZh: 雀、鹿、蜂、猴出现在一起：它们的中文名称与爵位、俸禄、封侯谐音——寄托陈氏子孙金榜题名、官运亨通的愿望。

senses.zh: a. 中国的, 中国话的
senses.enDef: n. a native or inhabitant of Communist China or of Nationalist China

senses.zh: n. 中文, 中国话, 中国人
senses.enDef: a. of or pertaining to China or its peoples or cultures

senses.zh: choice（上等的, 精选的）的最高级形式
senses.enDef: s of superior grade
senses.exampleEn: At the tops of the balusters are carved southern fruits: peach, star-fruit (carambola), papaya, lychee, and so on — symbolic sacrificial offerings of the choicest Lingnan fruits to the Chen ancestors.
senses.exampleZh: 栏杆顶端雕着南方水果：桃、杨桃、木瓜、荔枝等——象征把最精美的岭南佳果献给陈氏祖先。

senses.zh: choice（上等的, 精选的）的最高级形式
senses.enDef: s appealing to refined taste

senses.zh: n. 基督教, 基督教精神
senses.enDef: n. a monotheistic system of beliefs and practices based on the Old Testament and the teachings of Jesus as embodied in the New Testament and emphasizing the role of Jesus as savior
senses.exampleEn: Ever since childhood he was influenced by Western ideas of Christianity and democracy, and he made up his mind to cure the ills of old feudal China and turn it into a democratic, strong nation.
senses.exampleZh: 自幼受到西方基督教与民主思想影响，他立志医治旧中国的弊病，把它变成一个民主、强盛的国家。

senses.zh: n. 城市, 市
senses.enDef: n. a large and densely populated urban area; may include several independent administrative districts
senses.exampleEn: Today we visit Danxia Mountain, about forty-five kilometers northeast of Shaoguan City — a world-famous red-stone landscape and the namesake of a whole geological term.
senses.exampleZh: 今天我们游览丹霞山，它位于韶关市东北约四十五公里处——这里是世界著名的红石景观，也是一种地质术语的命名地。

senses.zh: [法] 都市, 城市, 市
senses.enDef: n. an incorporated administrative district established by state charter

senses.zh: n. 城市, 市
senses.enDef: n. people living in a large densely populated municipality

senses.zh: n. 氏族, 宗族, 集团
senses.enDef: n group of people related by blood or marriage
senses.exampleEn: Today we visit the Chen Family Temple, also called the Chen Clan Academy — the “Pearl of Lingnan Artistic Architecture” in the heart of Guangzhou.
senses.exampleZh: 今天我们参观陈家祠，也称陈氏书院——广州城中心的“岭南建筑艺术明珠”。

senses.zh: [医] 支
senses.enDef: n group of people related by blood or marriage

senses.zh: a. 氏族的, 宗族的, 团结心很强的
senses.enDef: s. characteristic of a clan especially in being unified
senses.exampleEn: This place served as a shrine for sacrifices to the common ancestors of the Chen families; as a venue for clannish activities on festive and other special occasions; and as a school for Chen children — hence “Chen Clan Academy.”
senses.exampleZh: 这里既是陈姓各房祭祀共同祖先的祠堂，也是节庆等特殊场合举行宗族活动的场所，还是陈氏子弟读书的学堂——所以叫“陈氏书院”。

senses.zh: a. 氏族的, 宗族的, 团结心很强的
senses.enDef: s. befitting or characteristic of those who incline to social exclusiveness and who rebuff the advances of people considered inferior

senses.zh: n. 族人, 同宗
senses.enDef: n. a member of a clan
senses.exampleEn: Here there is a concrete story: in 1893 — the year before the temple was completed — a clansman named Chen Botao won the rank of tanhua (third place in the palace examination), and these drums were mounted in his honor.
senses.exampleZh: 这里有个具体故事：一八九三年——祠堂建成前一年——族人陈伯陶 Chen Botao 考中探花（殿试第三名），这些石鼓就是为他而立的。

senses.zh: n. 班级, 阶级, 种类, 课
senses.enDef: n. a collection of things sharing a common attribute
senses.exampleEn: Finding so many sacrificial persons here shows this cruel custom was still practiced by Nanyue’s ruling class.
senses.exampleZh: 这里发现这么多殉人，说明南越统治阶级仍在实行这一残酷习俗。

senses.zh: vt. 分类
senses.enDef: n. a body of students who are taught together

senses.zh: [计] 类别; 类; 种类; 类程
senses.enDef: n. people having the same social, economic, or educational status

senses.zh: n. 班级, 阶级, 种类, 课
senses.enDef: n. a league ranked by quality

senses.zh: n. 古典作品, 杰作, 大艺术家
senses.enDef: n. a creation of the highest excellence
senses.exampleEn: Now, let’s walk the classic viewing route — from river to bridge, from “yang” to “yin,” and finally into the temple.
senses.exampleZh: 接下来，我们走经典观景路线——从江到桥，从“阳”到“阴”，最后进入寺庙。

senses.zh: a. 第一流的, 最优秀的, 古典的
senses.enDef: n. an artist who has created classic works

senses.zh: n. 教室
senses.enDef: n. a room in a school where lessons take place
senses.exampleEn: So Danxia is both a geology classroom and a picture book: an ancient lake turned red, a name that traveled the world, elephants in the river, a sleeping girl on the bridge, a stone couple of yin and yang, and a temple dragon that changes color.

senses.exampleZh: 楼顶有一座中西合璧的六角观景亭；五楼四角各有一个碉堡，又称“燕子窝”。整座楼体量宏大、气势雄伟，铁门铁窗厚重坚固，装饰豪华，生活设施齐全。

senses.exampleEn: But China’s defeats by foreign invaders and the corruption and incompetence of the Qing court intensified his patriotic indignation.
senses.exampleZh: 但中国在外敌面前接连失败，加上清廷腐败无能，使他的爱国义愤日益强烈。

senses.exampleZh: 在清代封建社会，只有家族中有人考取进士或更高功名，才能在门前摆放石鼓。

senses.exampleEn: Ever since childhood he was influenced by Western ideas of Christianity and democracy, and he made up his mind to cure the ills of old feudal China and turn it into a democratic, strong nation.
senses.exampleZh: 自幼受到西方基督教与民主思想影响，他立志医治旧中国的弊病，把它变成一个民主、强盛的国家。

senses.zh: a. 民主的
senses.enDef: a. characterized by or advocating or based upon the principles of democracy or social equality
senses.exampleEn: Welcome to the Sun Yat-sen Memorial Hall in Guangzhou — a landmark of China’s democratic revolution and a masterpiece of modern Chinese architecture.
senses.exampleZh: 欢迎来到广州中山纪念堂——中国民主革命的地标，也是中国近代建筑的杰作。

senses.zh: [法] 民主的, 民主政体的, 平民的

senses.exampleEn: Fangshi Denglou, built in 1920 by the Fang family, is the most typical watchtower: open land, spacious views, and a full defense kit — electric generator, searchlights, and guns.
senses.exampleZh: 方氏灯楼 Fangshi Denglou 由方氏家族建于一九二〇年，是最典型的更楼：地势开阔、视野宽广，防卫设备齐全——发电机、探照灯和枪支。

senses.exampleEn: On the walls beside the gate, brick carvings depict different stories from Chinese historical novels — representative works of Guangdong brick-carving.
senses.exampleZh: 大门两侧墙上的砖雕，刻画了中国历史小说中的不同故事——是广东砖雕的代表作。

senses.exampleZh: 设计者是年轻的中国建筑师吕彦直 Lu Yanzhi：生于天津，毕业于北京清华大学，后赴美国康奈尔大学学习建筑。

senses.exampleZh: 他把一生献给了这项事业；他所领导的辛亥革命，结束了延续数千年的封建帝制。

senses.zh: a. 投入的, 深爱的

senses.zh: n. 直径
senses.enDef: n. the length of a straight line passing through the center of a circle and connecting two points on the circumference
senses.exampleEn: Next is Yangyuan Hill, meaning “the Hill of Male Sex.” The famous stone column here — Yangyuan Stone — is about 28 meters high and 7 meters in diameter, and it looks strikingly like the male organ.
senses.exampleZh: 下一站是阳元山，意思是“男性之山”。这里著名的石柱——阳元石——高约二十八米，直径约七米，外形酷似男性生殖器。

senses.zh: n. 迪奥（姓氏）

senses.exampleEn: Today we explore Kaiping Diaolou and Villages in Jiangmen — an open-air museum where overseas Chinese dreams meet fortress walls.
senses.exampleZh: 今天我们探索江门的开平碉楼与村落——一座露天博物馆，华侨梦想与堡垒城墙在此相遇。

senses.exampleZh: 楼顶有一座中西合璧的六角观景亭；五楼四角各有一个碉堡，又称“燕子窝”。整座楼体量宏大、气势雄伟，铁门铁窗厚重坚固，装饰豪华，生活设施齐全。

senses.enDef: n the ripened reproductive body of a seed plant
senses.exampleEn: At the tops of the balusters are carved southern fruits: peach, star-fruit (carambola), papaya, lychee, and so on — symbolic sacrificial offerings of the choicest Lingnan fruits to the Chen ancestors.
senses.exampleZh: 栏杆顶端雕着南方水果：桃、杨桃、木瓜、荔枝等——象征把最精美的岭南佳果献给陈氏祖先。

senses.exampleZh: 请注意一个倒着的“福”字，常出现在木雕背面。

senses.zh: n. 全部, 完整
senses.enDef: v. beat for the purpose of cleaning and thickening
senses.exampleEn: That is the full Chen Family Temple toolkit from the white paper.
senses.exampleZh: 这就是白皮书中陈家祠的完整工具包。

senses.zh: adv. 十分地, 完全地, 充分地
senses.enDef: r. to the greatest degree or extent; completely or entirely; (`full' in this sense is used as a combining form)
senses.exampleEn: On top sits a Chinese–Western hexagonal observation pavilion; on the fifth floor, each of the four corners has a blockhouse — also called a “swallow’s nest.” The tower is huge and imposing, with heavy iron doors and strong iron windows, luxuriously decorated and fully furnished for daily life.
senses.exampleZh: 楼顶有一座中西合璧的六角观景亭；五楼四角各有一个碉堡，又称“燕子窝”。整座楼体量宏大、气势雄伟，铁门铁窗厚重坚固，装饰豪华，生活设施齐全。

senses.zh: a. 家具, 有家具的
senses.enDef: a. provided with whatever is necessary for a purpose (as furniture or equipment or authority)
senses.exampleEn: On top sits a Chinese–Western hexagonal observation pavilion; on the fifth floor, each of the four corners has a blockhouse — also called a “swallow’s nest.” The tower is huge and imposing, with heavy iron doors and strong iron windows, luxuriously decorated and fully furnished for daily life.
senses.exampleZh: 楼顶有一座中西合璧的六角观景亭；五楼四角各有一个碉堡，又称“燕子窝”。整座楼体量宏大、气势雄伟，铁门铁窗厚重坚固，装饰豪华，生活设施齐全。

senses.zh: n. 家具, 帆具
senses.enDef: n. furnishings that make a room or other area ready for occupancy
senses.exampleEn: In the villa area, residential buildings combine Chinese and Western elements: foreign-style main structures, some with Chinese palace-like roofs; inside you find Western fireplaces and pendant lamps, Italian ceramic tiles, Chinese wooden furniture (including rosewood-style pieces), folk-story murals, and gilded wood-carvings.
senses.exampleZh: 别墅区的住宅建筑中西合璧：主体多为洋式结构，有的屋顶却像中国宫殿；室内有西式壁炉与吊灯、意大利瓷砖，也有中式木家具（含红木风格）、民间故事壁画和鎏金木雕。

senses.zh: a. 更远的, 此外的, 更多的
senses.enDef: s. more distant in especially degree
senses.exampleEn: Further research is still needed.
senses.exampleZh: 还需要进一步研究。

senses.zh: vt. 促进, 增进, 助长
senses.enDef: r. to or at a greater extent or degree or a more advanced stage (`further' is used more often than `farther' in this abstract sense)

senses.zh: adv. 更进一步地, 更远地, 此外
senses.enDef: r. in addition or furthermore; further, they should be here already"

senses.zh: n. 熔合物, 结合, 熔合
senses.enDef: n. an occurrence that involves the production of a union
senses.exampleEn: At the start of the Western Han, the former Qin general Zhao Tuo founded the Nanyue Kingdom, promoting Han–Yue fusion.
senses.exampleZh: 西汉初年，原秦将赵佗 Zhao Tuo 建立南越国，推行汉越融合。

senses.zh: [化] 熔融; 熔化; 聚变

senses.zh: n. 熔合物, 结合, 熔合

senses.zh: n. 熔合物, 结合, 熔合
senses.enDef: n. the combining of images from the two eyes to form a single visual percept

senses.zh: n. 花园, 果园, 菜园
senses.enDef: n. a plot of ground where plants are cultivated
senses.exampleEn: The mountain covers 319 square kilometers, with over 600 red rock peaks standing out against green woods — like a garden of ruby sculptures.
senses.exampleZh: 这座山占地三百一十九平方公里，六百多座红岩峰峦挺立在绿林之间——像一座红宝石雕塑园。

senses.zh: vi. 栽培花木
senses.enDef: n. the flowers or vegetables or fruits or herbs that are cultivated in a garden

senses.zh: vt. 造园
senses.enDef: n. a yard or lawn adjoining a house

senses.zh: a. 花园的, 普通的
senses.enDef: v. work in the garden

senses.zh: n. 衣服, 衣装, 外表
senses.enDef: n. an article of clothing
senses.exampleEn: Zhao Mo’s garment was sewn with silk strands — the first and only silk-thread jade garment found in China so far.
senses.exampleZh: 赵眜的玉衣用丝缕编缀——这是中国迄今发现的第一件、也是唯一一件丝缕玉衣。

senses.zh: n. 服装, 衣着
senses.enDef: n an article of clothing
senses.exampleEn: Jade garments were a burial practice peculiar to the Han Dynasty.
senses.exampleZh: 玉衣是汉代特有的葬制。

senses.zh: n. 服装, 衣着
senses.enDef: v provide with clothes or put clothes on

senses.zh: n. 门, 牌楼, 大门, 通道, 闸
senses.enDef: n. a movable barrier in a fence or wall
senses.exampleEn: On the walls beside the gate, brick carvings depict different stories from Chinese historical novels — representative works of Guangdong brick-carving.
senses.exampleZh: 大门两侧墙上的砖雕，刻画了中国历史小说中的不同故事——是广东砖雕的代表作。

senses.zh: vt. 装门于

senses.zh: [计] 门; 栅

senses.zh: n. 门, 牌楼, 大门, 通道, 闸
senses.enDef: n. passageway (as in an air terminal) where passengers can embark or disembark

senses.zh: n. 碎褶；密褶（gather的复数）
senses.enDef: n sewing consisting of small folds or puckers made by pulling tight a thread in a line of stitching
senses.exampleEn: In decoration it gathers the finest Guangdong folk arts and crafts.
senses.exampleZh: 装饰上，它汇集了广东民间工艺的精华。

senses.exampleEn: At the start of the Western Han, the former Qin general Zhao Tuo founded the Nanyue Kingdom, promoting Han–Yue fusion.
senses.exampleZh: 西汉初年，原秦将赵佗 Zhao Tuo 建立南越国，推行汉越融合。

senses.zh: a. 全面的, 大体的, 总的, 一般的, 普遍的
senses.enDef: n. the head of a religious order or congregation

senses.enDef: n. a fact about the whole (as opposed to particular)

senses.zh: [计] 常规
senses.enDef: v. command as a general

senses.zh: n. 世代（generation的复数）
senses.enDef: n all the people living at the same time or of approximately the same age
senses.exampleEn: The chickens stand for the present generations; the banana’s big leaves (da ye) sound like “great property” or “great undertaking,” so they suggest the wealth and cause created by past generations.
senses.exampleZh: 鸡群代表今人；芭蕉的“大叶”与“大业”谐音，暗示先辈开创的财富与事业。

senses.zh: n. 世代（generation的复数）
senses.enDef: n group of genetically related organisms constituting a single step in the line of descent

senses.zh: n. 世代（generation的复数）
senses.enDef: n the normal time between successive generations

senses.zh: n. 世代（generation的复数）
senses.enDef: n a stage of technological development or innovation

senses.zh: n. 世代（generation的复数）
senses.enDef: n the production of heat or electricity

senses.zh: n. 产生器, 发电机, 生产者
senses.enDef: n. an apparatus that produces a vapor or gas
senses.exampleEn: Fangshi Denglou, built in 1920 by the Fang family, is the most typical watchtower: open land, spacious views, and a full defense kit — electric generator, searchlights, and guns.
senses.exampleZh: 方氏灯楼 Fangshi Denglou 由方氏家族建于一九二〇年，是最典型的更楼：地势开阔、视野宽广，防卫设备齐全——发电机、探照灯和枪支。

senses.zh: [计] 发生器
senses.enDef: n. engine that converts mechanical energy into electrical energy by electromagnetic induction

senses.zh: n. 产生器, 发电机, 生产者
senses.enDef: n. someone who originates or causes or initiates something

senses.zh: n. 产生器, 发电机, 生产者

senses.zh: pl. 出身高贵的人, 有教养的人, 绅士, 有身分的人, 阁下, 先生, (雅)男人
senses.enDef: n a man of refinement
senses.exampleEn: Good morning, ladies and gentlemen.
senses.exampleZh: 各位早上好。

senses.zh: n. 男厕所
senses.enDef: n a manservant who acts as a personal attendant to his employer

senses.zh: a. 地质学的, 地质的
senses.enDef: a. of or relating to or based on geology
senses.exampleEn: Today we visit Danxia Mountain, about forty-five kilometers northeast of Shaoguan City — a world-famous red-stone landscape and the namesake of a whole geological term.
senses.exampleZh: 今天我们游览丹霞山，它位于韶关市东北约四十五公里处——这里是世界著名的红石景观，也是一种地质术语的命名地。

senses.zh: n. 地质学家, 地质学者( geologist的复数形式 )
senses.enDef: n. a specialist in geology
senses.exampleEn: From then on, wherever you find landscapes of red sandstone conglomerate with sheer, red cliffs, geologists call them Danxia landform.
senses.exampleZh: 从那以后，凡是见到由红色砂砾岩构成、崖壁陡峭鲜红的景观，地质学家都称之为丹霞地貌。

senses.zh: n. 地质学, 地质情况
senses.enDef: n. a science that deals with the history of the earth as recorded in rocks
senses.exampleEn: So Danxia is both a geology classroom and a picture book: an ancient lake turned red, a name that traveled the world, elephants in the river, a sleeping girl on the bridge, a stone couple of yin and yang, and a temple dragon that changes color.
senses.exampleZh: 所以丹霞既是地质课堂，又是一本画册：古湖变红、名字走向世界、江中群象、桥上睡美人、阴阳石夫妻，还有会变色的寺中龙。

senses.zh: n. 德国
senses.enDef: n. a republic in central Europe; split into East Germany and West Germany after World War II and reunited in 1990
senses.exampleEn: Places featuring Danxia landform can be found on all continents except Antarctica — for example, the Grand Canyon in the United States and some areas in Saxony, Germany.
senses.exampleZh: 除南极洲外，各大洲都能找到丹霞地貌——比如美国的大峡谷，以及德国萨克森的一些地区。

senses.zh: n. 鬼；幽灵（ghost的复数）
senses.enDef: n a mental representation of some haunting experience
senses.exampleEn: The earliest were legendary Shentu and Yulei, said to catch ghosts and protect the house.
senses.exampleZh: 最早的门神是传说中的神荼和郁垒，据说能捉鬼护宅。

senses.zh: n. 鬼；幽灵（ghost的复数）
senses.enDef: n a writer who gives the credit of authorship to someone else

senses.zh: n. 鬼；幽灵（ghost的复数）
senses.enDef: n the visible disembodied soul of a dead person

senses.enDef: n a suggestion of some quality

senses.zh: n. 鬼；幽灵（ghost的复数）
senses.enDef: v move like a ghost

senses.zh: n. 鬼；幽灵（ghost的复数）
senses.enDef: v haunt like a ghost; pursue

senses.zh: a. 镀金的, 有钱的, 装饰的
senses.enDef: s. based on pretense; deceptively pleasing
senses.exampleEn: In the villa area, residential buildings combine Chinese and Western elements: foreign-style main structures, some with Chinese palace-like roofs; inside you find Western fireplaces and pendant lamps, Italian ceramic tiles, Chinese wooden furniture (including rosewood-style pieces), folk-story murals, and gilded wood-carvings.
senses.exampleZh: 别墅区的住宅建筑中西合璧：主体多为洋式结构，有的屋顶却像中国宫殿；室内有西式壁炉与吊灯、意大利瓷砖，也有中式木家具（含红木风格）、民间故事壁画和鎏金木雕。

senses.zh: gild的过去式和过去分词
senses.enDef: s. based on pretense; deceptively pleasing

senses.zh: n. 女孩, 少女, 女佣
senses.enDef: n. a young woman
senses.exampleEn: It looks like a young girl lying down to sleep: from right to left, her head, neck, chest, and belly are clearly outlined.
senses.exampleZh: 它像一位少女躺着入睡：从右到左，头、颈、胸、腹轮廓清晰。

senses.zh: n. 女孩, 少女, 女佣
senses.enDef: n. a friendly informal reference to a grown woman

senses.zh: a. 白热的, 灼热的, 通红的, 鲜艳的
senses.enDef: s. highly enthusiastic
senses.exampleEn: That is how the glowing red cliffs you see today were formed.
senses.exampleZh: 你们今天看到的这些鲜红崖壁，就是这样形成的。

senses.zh: [化] 辉光
senses.enDef: s. highly enthusiastic

senses.zh: n. 上帝, 神像, 偶像
senses.enDef: n. the supernatural being conceived as the perfect and omnipotent and omniscient originator and ruler of the universe; the object of worship in monotheistic religions
senses.exampleEn: In the family of Lingnan buildings, it stands among the great ritual / institutional landmarks — alongside places like the Temple of the South China Sea God and Foshan Ancestral Temple — while Kaiping’s watchtowers represent world-heritage vernacular fortresses.
senses.exampleZh: 在岭南建筑大家族里，它与南海神庙、佛山祖庙等并列，属于重要的礼制建筑；而开平碉楼则代表世界遗产级的民间堡垒建筑。

senses.zh: vt. 使神化
senses.enDef: n. a man of such superior qualities that he seems like a deity to other people

senses.zh: n. 黄金, 钱财, 金块, 金色, 宝贵
senses.enDef: n. coins made of gold
senses.exampleEn: Two thousand years under Elephant Hill still speak through jade, bronze, and gold.
senses.exampleZh: 象岗山下两千年的岁月，仍通过玉、青铜和黄金在诉说。

senses.zh: a. 金的, 似金的, 金色的, 金制的
senses.enDef: n. a soft yellow malleable ductile (trivalent and univalent) metallic element; occurs mainly as nuggets in rocks and alluvial deposits; does not react with most chemicals but is attacked by chlorine and aqua regia

senses.zh: n. 黄金, 钱财, 金块, 金色, 宝贵
senses.enDef: n. great wealth

senses.zh: n. 黄金, 钱财, 金块, 金色, 宝贵
senses.enDef: n. something likened to the metal in brightness or preciousness or superiority etc.

senses.exampleEn: A bronze tiger tally with gold inlay is the only gold-inlaying tiger tally still existing in China — a credential for troop movement or diplomacy.
senses.exampleZh: 一件错金铜虎节，是中国现存唯一的错金虎节——用于调兵或外交的凭证。

senses.zh: n. 铜锣, 皿形钟
senses.enDef: n. a percussion instrument consisting of a metal plate that is struck with a softheaded drumstick
senses.exampleEn: The spot under excavation matched the position of Chang Le Gong in the Han palace at Chang’an — so was this Nanyue’s “Chang Le Gong”?
senses.exampleZh: 发掘位置与汉长安宫中的长乐宫位置相对应——那么这里会是南越的“长乐宫”吗？

senses.zh: vt. 鸣锣召唤
senses.enDef: v. sound a gong

senses.zh: n. 善行, 好处, 利益
senses.enDef: n. benefit
senses.exampleEn: Notice an inverted character for happiness / good fortune (fu), often on the reverse of a wood-carving.
senses.exampleZh: 请注意一个倒着的“福”字，常出现在木雕背面。

senses.zh: a. 好的, 优良的, 上等的, 愉快的, 有益的, 好心的, 慈善的, 虔诚的
senses.enDef: n. moral excellence or admirableness

senses.zh: n. 善行, 好处, 利益
senses.enDef: n. that which is pleasing or valuable or useful

senses.zh: n. 善行, 好处, 利益
senses.enDef: a. having desirable or positive qualities especially those suitable for a thing specified

senses.zh: abbr. gourde (Haitian currency) 古德（海地货币和硬币名）
senses.exampleEn: Especially worth mentioning is a chime of bronzes called “Gou Diao”: eight pieces, cast with the epigraph “Made in the Official Conservatory in the Ninth Year of Emperor Wen,” showing they were made in Nanyue in 129 BC.
senses.exampleZh: 尤其值得一提的是一组青铜乐器“句鑃”Gou Diao：共八件，铸有铭文“文帝九年乐府工造”，说明它们于公元前一二九年在南越制成。

senses.zh: n. 政府, 内阁
senses.enDef: n. the organization that is the governing authority of a political unit
senses.exampleEn: Before we meet the tomb owner, one short map of history: in Pre-Qin times this region was home to the Nan Yue people; after Qin unified Lingnan, Nanhai Prefecture was set up here — and today’s Guangzhou grew from that seat of government.
senses.exampleZh: 在认识墓主之前，先快速回顾一段历史：先秦时期这一带是南越人的家园；秦统一岭南后，在此设南海郡——今天的广州，就从这座郡治发展而来。

senses.zh: [经] 政府, 政治, 政体
senses.enDef: n. the act of governing; exercising authority

senses.zh: n. 政府, 内阁
senses.enDef: n. (government) the system or form by which a community or other political unit is governed

senses.zh: adv. 逐渐地
senses.enDef: r. in a gradual manner
senses.exampleEn: Later, movements of the earth’s crust lifted the land; the lake water receded; and the sediment at the bottom gradually oxidized into red rocks.
senses.exampleZh: 后来地壳运动抬升了地面，湖水退去，湖底的沉积物逐渐氧化成红色岩石。

senses.exampleEn: Ruishilou is the highest and most luxurious tower in Kaiping: nine storeys, about 25 meters high, armored concrete, with elegant traditional Chinese interiors — rated the No. 1 tower in Kaiping.
senses.exampleZh: 瑞石楼 Ruishilou 是开平最高、最豪华的碉楼：九层，高约二十五米，钢筋混凝土结构，内部为中国传统雅致装修——被评为开平第一楼。

senses.exampleEn: On top sits a Chinese–Western hexagonal observation pavilion; on the fifth floor, each of the four corners has a blockhouse — also called a “swallow’s nest.” The tower is huge and imposing, with heavy iron doors and strong iron windows, luxuriously decorated and fully furnished for daily life.
senses.exampleZh: 楼顶有一座中西合璧的六角观景亭；五楼四角各有一个碉堡，又称“燕子窝”。整座楼体量宏大、气势雄伟，铁门铁窗厚重坚固，装饰豪华，生活设施齐全。

senses.exampleZh: 栏杆顶端雕着南方水果：桃、杨桃、木瓜、荔枝等——象征把最精美的岭南佳果献给陈氏祖先。

senses.exampleZh: 它像一位少女躺着入睡：从右到左，头、颈、胸、腹轮廓清晰。

senses.exampleZh: 楼顶有一座中西合璧的六角观景亭；五楼四角各有一个碉堡，又称“燕子窝”。整座楼体量宏大、气势雄伟，铁门铁窗厚重坚固，装饰豪华，生活设施齐全。

senses.exampleZh: 今天我们探索江门的开平碉楼与村落——一座露天博物馆，华侨梦想与堡垒城墙在此相遇。

senses.zh: adv. 在海外, 在国外

senses.exampleZh: 它们共同证明赵眜僭越称帝，脱离汉朝而行使地方权力。

senses.zh: overthrow的过去分词

senses.exampleEn: He decided the Qing was rotten to the core and must be overthrown and replaced by a democratic republic.

senses.exampleZh: 美籍华人园主谢维立取自自己的名字，也寄托着园中牌坊所写的“修身立本”——培养品德是成功的根本。

senses.exampleZh: 后来地壳运动抬升了地面，湖水退去，湖底的沉积物逐渐氧化成红色岩石。

senses.zh: n. 宫, 宫殿, 华丽大厦

senses.exampleZh: 这里有个具体故事：一八九三年——祠堂建成前一年——族人陈伯陶 Chen Botao 考中探花（殿试第三名），这些石鼓就是为他而立的。

senses.exampleEn: In the villa area, residential buildings combine Chinese and Western elements: foreign-style main structures, some with Chinese palace-like roofs; inside you find Western fireplaces and pendant lamps, Italian ceramic tiles, Chinese wooden furniture (including rosewood-style pieces), folk-story murals, and gilded wood-carvings.
senses.exampleZh: 别墅区的住宅建筑中西合璧：主体多为洋式结构，有的屋顶却像中国宫殿；室内有西式壁炉与吊灯、意大利瓷砖，也有中式木家具（含红木风格）、民间故事壁画和鎏金木雕。

senses.exampleZh: 栏杆顶端雕着南方水果：桃、杨桃、木瓜、荔枝等——象征把最精美的岭南佳果献给陈氏祖先。

senses.exampleZh: 所以它又被称为中国红石公园，或中国红宝石公园 China Ruby Park。

senses.exampleEn: Geological studies show it was once part of the cliff; over three hundred thousand years, Nature severed it from the mountain and carved it into this shape.
senses.exampleZh: 地质研究表明，它原是崖壁的一部分；历经约三十万年，大自然把它从山体分离，并雕成今天的样子。

senses.exampleZh: 记住三组数字——三千三百、一千八百三十三、二十；三座楼名——铭石、瑞石、方氏；还有一句园中话——修身立本 Xiu Shen Li Ben——景点问答和口译段落你都能应对。

senses.zh: n. 楼阁, 亭子, 大帐篷, 观众席

senses.exampleEn: On top sits a Chinese–Western hexagonal observation pavilion; on the fifth floor, each of the four corners has a blockhouse — also called a “swallow’s nest.” The tower is huge and imposing, with heavy iron doors and strong iron windows, luxuriously decorated and fully furnished for daily life.
senses.exampleZh: 楼顶有一座中西合璧的六角观景亭；五楼四角各有一个碉堡，又称“燕子窝”。整座楼体量宏大、气势雄伟，铁门铁窗厚重坚固，装饰豪华，生活设施齐全。

senses.zh: vt. 置...于亭中, 搭帐篷, 笼罩

senses.zh: n. （公园中的）亭( pavilion的复数形式 ); （公共活动或展览用的）临时建筑物; 临时展出馆; 大型文体馆

senses.exampleEn: Main sights include the “Li Yuan” arched gate, the “Xiu Shen Li Ben” decorated archway, four bridge pavilions, and two Roman-style structures — the “Bird’s Nest” and the “Vine Pavilion.”

senses.exampleZh: 栏杆顶端雕着南方水果：桃、杨桃、木瓜、荔枝等——象征把最精美的岭南佳果献给陈氏祖先。

senses.exampleEn: Motifs carry meaning: the peony for richness and wealth, twin lotus flowers on one stalk for an affectionate couple, and the lion for power and dignity.
senses.exampleZh: 图案都有寓意：牡丹象征富贵，并蒂莲象征恩爱夫妻，狮子象征威严与权势。

senses.exampleEn: One pearl, three roles; at the gate — drums of Chen Botao the tanhua, the bird-deer-bee-monkey wish for rank and salary, brick stories and door-gods; inside — six crafts and peony-lotus-lion meanings, inverted fortune, Lingnan fruits, banana “great undertaking,” a picture teaching that learning takes years; and Emperor Shun in the rear hall.
senses.exampleZh: 一颗明珠，三重功能；门前——探花陈伯陶的石鼓、雀鹿蜂猴祈爵禄、砖雕故事与门神；祠内——六大工艺与牡丹莲狮寓意、倒福、岭南佳果、芭蕉“大业”、劝学需年岁的画，以及后堂的舜帝。

senses.exampleZh: 地质研究表明，它原是崖壁的一部分；历经约三十万年，大自然把它从山体分离，并雕成今天的样子。

senses.zh: sew的过去分词
senses.enDef: v fasten by sewing; do needlework
senses.exampleEn: Elsewhere they were usually sewn with gold, silver, or bronze strands.
senses.exampleZh: 别处通常用金缕、银缕或铜缕编缀。

senses.zh: sew的过去分词
senses.enDef: v create (clothes) with cloth

senses.zh: sew的过去分词
senses.enDef: s fastened with stitches

senses.zh: n. 性别, 性欲
senses.enDef: n. either of the two categories (male or female) into which most organisms are divided
senses.exampleEn: Next is Yangyuan Hill, meaning “the Hill of Male Sex.” The famous stone column here — Yangyuan Stone — is about 28 meters high and 7 meters in diameter, and it looks strikingly like the male organ.
senses.exampleZh: 下一站是阳元山，意思是“男性之山”。这里著名的石柱——阳元石——高约二十八米，直径约七米，外形酷似男性生殖器。

senses.zh: vt. 区别...的性别, 引起...的性欲
senses.enDef: n. all of the feelings resulting from the urge to gratify sexual impulses

senses.zh: n. 性别, 性欲
senses.enDef: n. the properties that distinguish organisms on the basis of their reproductive roles

senses.zh: n. 性别, 性欲
senses.enDef: v. tell the sex (of young chickens)

senses.zh: n. 商（中国古朝代名）
senses.enDef: n. the imperial dynasty ruling China from about the 18th to the 12th centuries BC
senses.exampleEn: Burying the living with dead sovereigns had prevailed in Central China in the Shang and Zhou dynasties (1766–770 BC), but was largely abolished in the Han Dynasty (206 BC–AD 220).
senses.exampleZh: 活人殉葬在商周时期（公元前一七六六至七七〇年）曾盛行于中原，到汉代（公元前二〇六至公元二二〇年）已基本废除。

senses.exampleEn: Today we visit Danxia Mountain, about forty-five kilometers northeast of Shaoguan City — a world-famous red-stone landscape and the namesake of a whole geological term.
senses.exampleZh: 今天我们游览丹霞山，它位于韶关市东北约四十五公里处——这里是世界著名的红石景观，也是一种地质术语的命名地。

senses.zh: n. 形状, 形态, 外形, 形式, 身材
senses.enDef: n. any spatial attributes (especially as defined by outline)
senses.exampleEn: Another picture suggests that a young man may learn quickly, but great learning takes years to shape — like the English proverb “Rome was not built in a day.” It encourages people to study with perennial efforts.
senses.exampleZh: 另一幅图暗示：年轻人或许学得快，但大学问需要经年累月才能成就——就像英语谚语“罗马不是一日建成的”。它鼓励人们持之以恒地学习。

senses.zh: vt. 定形, 使成形, 塑造, 计划, 使符合
senses.enDef: n. the spatial arrangement of something as distinct from its substance

senses.zh: vi. 成形, 形成, 成长
senses.enDef: n. a concrete representation of an otherwise nebulous concept

senses.zh: [计] 形状
senses.enDef: v. make something, usually for a specific function

senses.zh: a. 成某种形状的, 制成一定形状的, 有某种形状的, 合适的, 计划好的, 有目标的
senses.enDef: s. shaped to fit by or as if by altering the contours of a pliable mass (as by work or effort)
senses.exampleEn: Inside the Sakyamuni Hall, please look at a rock shaped like a dragon.
senses.exampleZh: 在大雄宝殿里，请看一块形似龙的岩石。

senses.zh: [医] 具形的, 形似的
senses.enDef: a. having the shape of

senses.zh: a. 绝对的, 全然的, 纯粹的, 透明的, 峻峭的
senses.enDef: v. cause to sheer
senses.exampleEn: From then on, wherever you find landscapes of red sandstone conglomerate with sheer, red cliffs, geologists call them Danxia landform.
senses.exampleZh: 从那以后，凡是见到由红色砂砾岩构成、崖壁陡峭鲜红的景观，地质学家都称之为丹霞地貌。

senses.zh: vi. 偏转, 偏航
senses.enDef: r. straight up or down without a break

senses.zh: vt. 使急转向, 使偏航
senses.enDef: r. directly

senses.zh: adv. 完全, 全然, 峻峭
senses.enDef: v. cause to sheer

senses.zh: n. 偏航
senses.enDef: v. cause to sheer

senses.zh: n. 沈（姓氏）
senses.exampleEn: The American Chinese owner Xie Weili took the name from his own name, and it expresses the idiom Xiu Shen Li Ben — “cultivating one’s moral character is the foundation of success” — written on an archway in the garden.
senses.exampleZh: 美籍华人园主谢维立取自自己的名字，也寄托着园中牌坊所写的“修身立本”——培养品德是成功的根本。

senses.exampleEn: The earliest were legendary Shentu and Yulei, said to catch ghosts and protect the house.
senses.exampleZh: 最早的门神是传说中的神荼和郁垒，据说能捉鬼护宅。

senses.zh: a. 短的, 近的, 矮的, 短期的, 简短的, 少量的
senses.enDef: n. the location on a baseball field where the shortstop is stationed
senses.exampleEn: Before we meet the tomb owner, one short map of history: in Pre-Qin times this region was home to the Nan Yue people; after Qin unified Lingnan, Nanhai Prefecture was set up here — and today’s Guangzhou grew from that seat of government.
senses.exampleZh: 在认识墓主之前，先快速回顾一段历史：先秦时期这一带是南越人的家园；秦统一岭南后，在此设南海郡——今天的广州，就从这座郡治发展而来。

senses.zh: adv. 简短地, 突然
senses.enDef: a. primarily temporal sense; indicating or being or seeming to be limited in duration

senses.zh: n. 扼要, 短片, 缺乏
senses.enDef: a. (primarily spatial sense) having little length or lacking in length

senses.zh: vt. 故意少给, 使短路
senses.enDef: a. low in stature; not tall

senses.zh: n. 显示, 表现, 展览, 卖弄, 炫耀, 外观, 演出, 洋相
senses.enDef: n. the act of publicly exhibiting or entertaining
senses.exampleEn: Geological studies show that twenty-five million years ago, this place was a vast, low-lying lake.
senses.exampleZh: 地质研究表明，两千五百万年前，这里还是一片广阔低洼的湖泊。

senses.zh: vt. 表示, 显示, 展现, 陈列, 演出, 表明, 指出, 带领
senses.enDef: n. a social event involving a public performance or entertainment

senses.zh: vi. 露面, 显现, 演出
senses.enDef: v. give an exhibition of to an interested audience

senses.zh: [计] 显示
senses.enDef: v. make visible or noticeable

senses.zh: n. 显示, 陈列, 展览, 成绩, 表现, 表演, 夸耀, 陈述, 叙述, 外表, 迹象
senses.enDef: n the display of a motion picture
senses.exampleEn: Especially worth mentioning is a chime of bronzes called “Gou Diao”: eight pieces, cast with the epigraph “Made in the Official Conservatory in the Ninth Year of Emperor Wen,” showing they were made in Nanyue in 129 BC.
senses.exampleZh: 尤其值得一提的是一组青铜乐器“句鑃”Gou Diao：共八件，铸有铭文“文帝九年乐府工造”，说明它们于公元前一二九年在南越制成。

senses.zh: n. 显示, 陈列, 展览, 成绩, 表现, 表演, 夸耀, 陈述, 叙述, 外表, 迹象
senses.enDef: n something shown to the public

senses.zh: n. 显示, 陈列, 展览, 成绩, 表现, 表演, 夸耀, 陈述, 叙述, 外表, 迹象
senses.enDef: v give an exhibition of to an interested audience

senses.zh: n. 显示, 陈列, 展览, 成绩, 表现, 表演, 夸耀, 陈述, 叙述, 外表, 迹象
senses.enDef: v establish the validity of something, as by an example, explanation or experiment

senses.zh: n. 显示, 陈列, 展览, 成绩, 表现, 表演, 夸耀, 陈述, 叙述, 外表, 迹象
senses.enDef: v provide evidence for

senses.zh: n. 显示, 陈列, 展览, 成绩, 表现, 表演, 夸耀, 陈述, 叙述, 外表, 迹象
senses.enDef: v make visible or noticeable

senses.zh: n. 秀场, 表演（show的复数）
senses.enDef: n the act of publicly exhibiting or entertaining
senses.exampleEn: Finding so many sacrificial persons here shows this cruel custom was still practiced by Nanyue’s ruling class.
senses.exampleZh: 这里发现这么多殉人，说明南越统治阶级仍在实行这一残酷习俗。

senses.zh: n. 秀场, 表演（show的复数）
senses.enDef: n something intended to communicate a particular impression

senses.zh: n. 秀场, 表演（show的复数）
senses.enDef: n a social event involving a public performance or entertainment

senses.zh: n. 秀场, 表演（show的复数）
senses.enDef: n pretending that something is the case in order to make a good impression

senses.zh: n. 秀场, 表演（show的复数）
senses.enDef: v give an exhibition of to an interested audience

senses.zh: n. 秀场, 表演（show的复数）
senses.enDef: v establish the validity of something, as by an example, explanation or experiment

senses.zh: vt. 避开, 规避, 避免
senses.enDef: v. avoid and stay away from deliberately; stay clear of
senses.exampleEn: Tablets on the shrine were arranged by seniority; at the highest place was Emperor Shun, believed to be the remote ancestor of the Chen family, with later generations below.
senses.exampleZh: 神龛上的牌位按辈分排列；最高处是舜帝，被认为是陈氏远祖，后世列于其下。

senses.zh: n. 旁边, 侧, 方面, 胁, 侧边, 血统
senses.enDef: n. a place within a region identified relative to a center or reference location
senses.exampleEn: Please also notice, on the right-hand side behind the stone drum, a relief called “to be conferred a title of nobility” (Jue Lu Feng Hou).
senses.exampleZh: 请再看石鼓右侧后方的浮雕，叫“爵禄封侯” Jue Lu Feng Hou。

senses.zh: a. 旁的, 侧的, 次要的
senses.enDef: n. one of two or more contesting groups

senses.zh: vt. 同意, 支持
senses.enDef: n. either the left or right half of a body

senses.zh: vi. 支持, 赞助
senses.enDef: n. a surface forming part of the outside of an object

senses.zh: n. 边；面数；台词表（side的复数形式）
senses.enDef: n a place within a region identified relative to a center or reference location
senses.exampleEn: Stone drums on both sides symbolize social status.
senses.exampleZh: 两侧的石鼓象征社会地位。

senses.zh: n. 边；面数；台词表（side的复数形式）
senses.enDef: n one of two or more contesting groups

senses.zh: n. 边；面数；台词表（side的复数形式）
senses.enDef: n either the left or right half of a body

senses.zh: n. 边；面数；台词表（side的复数形式）
senses.enDef: n a surface forming part of the outside of an object

senses.zh: n. 边；面数；台词表（side的复数形式）
senses.enDef: n an extended outer surface of an object

senses.zh: n. 边；面数；台词表（side的复数形式）
senses.enDef: n an aspect of something (as contrasted with some other implied aspect)

senses.zh: n. 景观, 视力, 眼界, 阅读, 见解, 意见
senses.enDef: n. an instance of visual perception
senses.exampleEn: So this sight is named “The Elephants Crossing the River.”
senses.exampleZh: 所以这处景观叫作“群象过江” The Elephants Crossing the River。

senses.zh: vt. 看见, 瞄准
senses.enDef: n. anything that is seen

senses.zh: vi. 瞄准, 观看
senses.enDef: n. the ability to see; the visual faculty

senses.zh: a. 即席的, 见票即付的
senses.enDef: n. a range of mental vision

senses.zh: n. 风景, 名胜；视野（sight的复数）
senses.enDef: n. an optical instrument for aiding the eye in aiming, as on a firearm or surveying instrument
senses.exampleEn: Main sights include the “Li Yuan” arched gate, the “Xiu Shen Li Ben” decorated archway, four bridge pavilions, and two Roman-style structures — the “Bird’s Nest” and the “Vine Pavilion.”
senses.exampleZh: 主要景点包括“立园”拱门、“修身立本”牌坊、四座桥亭，以及两座罗马式建筑——“鸟巢”和“藤亭”。

senses.zh: n. 丝, 绸, 绸锻类, 丝织品
senses.enDef: n. a fabric made from the fine threads produced by certain insect larvae
senses.exampleEn: Zhao Mo’s garment was sewn with silk strands — the first and only silk-thread jade garment found in China so far.
senses.exampleZh: 赵眜的玉衣用丝缕编缀——这是中国迄今发现的第一件、也是唯一一件丝缕玉衣。

senses.zh: a. 丝的, 丝织的
senses.enDef: n. animal fibers produced by silkworms and other larvae that spin cocoons and by most spiders

senses.exampleEn: Zhao Mo’s garment was sewn with silk strands — the first and only silk-thread jade garment found in China so far.
senses.exampleZh: 赵眜的玉衣用丝缕编缀——这是中国迄今发现的第一件、也是唯一一件丝缕玉衣。

senses.zh: n. 银, 银币, 银器
senses.enDef: n. a soft white precious univalent metallic element having the highest electrical and thermal conductivity of any metal; occurs in argentite and in free form; used in coins and jewelry and tableware and photography
senses.exampleEn: Elsewhere they were usually sewn with gold, silver, or bronze strands.
senses.exampleZh: 别处通常用金缕、银缕或铜缕编缀。

senses.zh: a. 银的, 银制的, 银器的
senses.enDef: n. coins made of silver

senses.zh: vt. 镀银
senses.enDef: v. coat with a layer of silver or a silver amalgam

senses.zh: vi. 变银白色
senses.enDef: v. make silver in color

senses.zh: n. 银器
senses.enDef: n. tableware made of silver or silver plate or pewter or stainless steel
senses.exampleEn: One silver box, by shape and ornament so different from traditional Chinese silverware, and by chemical analysis of the pills inside, is believed to be a product from overseas Persia, with contents likely a kind of Arabian medicine — evidence of early maritime contact.
senses.exampleZh: 有一件银盒，从造型和纹饰看与中国传统银器截然不同；对盒内丸药的化学分析显示，它很可能来自海外波斯，内容物似为一种阿拉伯药物——这是早期海上交往的证据。

senses.zh: prep. 自...以后, 自...以来
senses.enDef: adv. From a definite past time until now; as, he went a month
senses.exampleEn: Ever since childhood he was influenced by Western ideas of Christianity and democracy, and he made up his mind to cure the ills of old feudal China and turn it into a democratic, strong nation.
senses.exampleZh: 自幼受到西方基督教与民主思想影响，他立志医治旧中国的弊病，把它变成一个民主、强盛的国家。

senses.zh: adv. 自那时以后
senses.enDef: ago, and I have not seen him since.

senses.zh: conj. 既然, 自...以后, 自...以来
senses.enDef: adv. In the time past, counting backward from the present;

senses.zh: prep. 自...以后, 自...以来
senses.enDef: before this or now; ago.

senses.zh: prep. 自...以后, 自...以来
senses.enDef: adv. When or that.

senses.zh: prep. 自...以后, 自...以来
senses.enDef: prep. From the time of; in or during the time subsequent to;

senses.zh: n. 位置, 场所, 地点
senses.enDef: n. the piece of land on which something is located (or is to be located)
senses.exampleEn: Hold three numbers — 3,300 / 1,833 / 20 — three tower names — Mingshi, Ruishi, Fangshi — and one garden phrase — Xiu Shen Li Ben — and you can answer both scenic questions and interpretation passages on this site.
senses.exampleZh: 记住三组数字——三千三百、一千八百三十三、二十；三座楼名——铭石、瑞石、方氏；还有一句园中话——修身立本 Xiu Shen Li Ben——景点问答和口译段落你都能应对。

senses.zh: vt. 给...择址
senses.enDef: n. physical position in relation to the surroundings

senses.zh: v. 坐（sit的第三人称单数形式）
senses.enDef: v be seated
senses.exampleEn: On top sits a Chinese–Western hexagonal observation pavilion; on the fifth floor, each of the four corners has a blockhouse — also called a “swallow’s nest.” The tower is huge and imposing, with heavy iron doors and strong iron windows, luxuriously decorated and fully furnished for daily life.
senses.exampleZh: 楼顶有一座中西合璧的六角观景亭；五楼四角各有一个碉堡，又称“燕子窝”。整座楼体量宏大、气势雄伟，铁门铁窗厚重坚固，装饰豪华，生活设施齐全。

senses.zh: v. 坐（sit的第三人称单数形式）
senses.enDef: v be around, often idly or without specific purpose

senses.zh: v. 坐（sit的第三人称单数形式）
senses.enDef: v take a seat

senses.zh: v. 坐（sit的第三人称单数形式）
senses.enDef: v be in session

senses.zh: v. 坐（sit的第三人称单数形式）
senses.enDef: v assume a posture as for artistic purposes

senses.zh: v. 坐（sit的第三人称单数形式）
senses.enDef: v sit and travel on the back of animal, usually while controlling its motions

senses.zh: num. 六, 六个
senses.enDef: n. the cardinal number that is the sum of five and one
senses.exampleEn: One pearl, three roles; at the gate — drums of Chen Botao the tanhua, the bird-deer-bee-monkey wish for rank and salary, brick stories and door-gods; inside — six crafts and peony-lotus-lion meanings, inverted fortune, Lingnan fruits, banana “great undertaking,” a picture teaching that learning takes years; and Emperor Shun in the rear hall.
senses.exampleZh: 一颗明珠，三重功能；门前——探花陈伯陶的石鼓、雀鹿蜂猴祈爵禄、砖雕故事与门神；祠内——六大工艺与牡丹莲狮寓意、倒福、岭南佳果、芭蕉“大业”、劝学需年岁的画，以及后堂的舜帝。

senses.zh: num. 六, 六个
senses.enDef: s. denoting a quantity consisting of six items or units

senses.zh: num. 十六, 十六个
senses.enDef: n. the cardinal number that is the sum of fifteen and one
senses.exampleEn: He came to the throne in the fourth year of Emperor Wu’s Jianyuan era and reigned sixteen years, from 137 to 122 BC.
senses.exampleZh: 他在汉武帝建元四年即位，在位十六年，从公元前一三七到一二二年。

senses.zh: num. 十六, 十六个
senses.enDef: s. being one more than fifteen

senses.zh: n. 大小, 尺寸, 规模, 尺码, 能力, 浆料
senses.enDef: n. the physical magnitude of something (how big it is)
senses.exampleEn: This is the most important Han tomb so far found in South China — the largest in size, the occupant of the highest political and social status, and the richest in unearthed relics.
senses.exampleZh: 这是迄今华南发现的最重要的汉代墓葬——规模最大、墓主人政治社会地位最高、出土文物也最丰富。

senses.zh: vt. 上浆, 依大小排列
senses.enDef: n. the property resulting from being one of a series of graduated measurements (as of clothing)

senses.zh: vi. 可比拟
senses.enDef: n. any glutinous material used to fill pores in surfaces or to stiffen fabrics

senses.zh: a. 一定大小的, 一定尺寸的
senses.enDef: n. the actual state of affairs

senses.zh: n. 技术, 技巧, 技能, 熟练, 熟练工人
senses.enDef: n. an ability that has been acquired by training
senses.exampleEn: They reflect Nanyue metal-casting skill and serve as important evidence for the founding history of Guangzhou.
senses.exampleZh: 它们反映了南越的金属铸造技艺，也是广州建城史的重要证据。

senses.zh: [化] 技能
senses.enDef: n. ability to produce solutions in some problem domain

senses.zh: n. 天涯, 地平线, 空中轮廓线
senses.enDef: n. the outline of objects seen against the sky
senses.exampleEn: Kaiping is safety, wealth, and cultural mixing in one skyline.
senses.exampleZh: 开平把安全、财富与文化交融，浓缩在同一片天际线上。

senses.zh: n. 睡眠, 静止, 昏迷, 麻木, 长眠, 冬眠
senses.enDef: n. a natural and periodic state of rest during which consciousness of the world is suspended
senses.exampleEn: It looks like a young girl lying down to sleep: from right to left, her head, neck, chest, and belly are clearly outlined.
senses.exampleZh: 它像一位少女躺着入睡：从右到左，头、颈、胸、腹轮廓清晰。

senses.zh: vi. 睡觉, 睡眠, 静止
senses.enDef: n. a torpid state resembling deep sleep

senses.zh: vt. 睡
senses.enDef: n. a period of time spent sleeping

senses.zh: n. 睡眠, 静止, 昏迷, 麻木, 长眠, 冬眠
senses.enDef: v. be asleep

senses.zh: n. 睡眠
senses.enDef: n. the state of being asleep
senses.exampleEn: This sight is called “The Sleeping Belle,” or “The Beautiful Girl Blocking the River” — Yu Nü Lan Jiang.
senses.exampleZh: 这处景观叫“睡美人” The Sleeping Belle，也叫“玉女拦江” Yu Nü Lan Jiang。

senses.zh: a. 睡着的
senses.enDef: n. the suspension of consciousness and decrease in metabolic rate

senses.zh: a. 小的, 少的, 小型的, 低微的, 小气的, 细微的
senses.enDef: n. the slender part of the back
senses.exampleEn: The garden has three areas: villa area, big garden area, and small garden area.
senses.exampleZh: 园林分三个区域：别墅区、大花园区和小花园区。

senses.zh: adv. 些微地
senses.enDef: n. a garment size for a small person

senses.zh: n. 狭小部分
senses.enDef: a. limited or below average in number or quantity or magnitude or extent

senses.zh: a. 小的, 少的, 小型的, 低微的, 小气的, 细微的
senses.enDef: s. slight or limited; especially in degree or intensity or scope

senses.zh: adv. 如此, 如是, 如...那样
senses.enDef: r. to a very great extent or degree
senses.exampleEn: In Chinese, “inversion” and “advent” are homophones, so an upside-down fu means “the advent of good fortune” — happiness has arrived.
senses.exampleZh: 中文里“倒”与“到”谐音，所以倒福意味着“福到了”——幸福已经到来。

senses.zh: conj. 所以, 因此
senses.enDef: r. in a manner that facilitates

senses.zh: pron. 这样
senses.enDef: r. in such a condition or manner, especially as expressed or implied

senses.zh: adv. 如此, 如是, 如...那样
senses.enDef: r. to a certain unspecified extent or degree

senses.zh: a. 社会的, 群居的, 社交的
senses.enDef: a. relating to human society and its members
senses.exampleEn: Stone drums on both sides symbolize social status.
senses.exampleZh: 两侧的石鼓象征社会地位。

senses.zh: n. 联欢会
senses.enDef: a. living together or enjoying life in communities or organized groups

senses.zh: a. 社会的, 群居的, 社交的
senses.enDef: a. relating to or belonging to or characteristic of high society

senses.zh: a. 社会的, 群居的, 社交的
senses.enDef: s. composed of sociable people or formed for the purpose of sociability

senses.zh: n. 社会；社交界；交往；社团
senses.enDef: n. an extended social group having a distinctive cultural and economic organization
senses.exampleEn: In feudal Qing society, a family could place drums before the house only when someone had earned the degree of jinshi or higher.
senses.exampleZh: 在清代封建社会，只有家族中有人考取进士或更高功名，才能在门前摆放石鼓。

senses.zh: n. 社会；社交界；交往；社团
senses.enDef: n. the fashionable elite

senses.zh: n. 固体
senses.enDef: n. matter that is solid at room temperature and pressure
senses.exampleEn: So these solid high-rises served both as defense against bandits and as refuge from floods.
senses.exampleZh: 所以这些坚固的高层建筑，既能防匪，又能避洪。

senses.zh: a. 坚硬的, 稳固的, 固体的, 实心的, 纯质的, 立体的, 立方的
senses.enDef: n. the state in which a substance has no tendency to flow under moderate stress; resists forces (such as compression) that tend to deform it; and retains a definite size and shape

senses.zh: [计] 原色
senses.enDef: n. a three-dimensional shape

senses.zh: n. 固体
senses.enDef: s. characterized by good substantial quality

senses.zh: pron. 一些, 一部分, 若干
senses.enDef: a. quantifier; used with either mass nouns or plural count nouns to indicate an unspecified number or quantity
senses.exampleEn: Places featuring Danxia landform can be found on all continents except Antarctica — for example, the Grand Canyon in the United States and some areas in Saxony, Germany.
senses.exampleZh: 除南极洲外，各大洲都能找到丹霞地貌——比如美国的大峡谷，以及德国萨克森的一些地区。

senses.zh: adv. 大约
senses.enDef: s. relatively much but unspecified in amount or extent

senses.zh: a. 一些的, 少许的, 某一的
senses.enDef: s. relatively many but unspecified in number

senses.zh: pron. 一些, 一部分, 若干
senses.enDef: s. remarkable

senses.zh: pron. 有人, 某人
senses.enDef: n a human being
senses.exampleEn: In feudal Qing society, a family could place drums before the house only when someone had earned the degree of jinshi or higher.
senses.exampleZh: 在清代封建社会，只有家族中有人考取进士或更高功名，才能在门前摆放石鼓。

senses.zh: n. 儿子们（son的复数）；子弟
senses.enDef: n a male human offspring
senses.exampleEn: In the old days, men were regarded as superior to women, and people prayed for more sons to carry on the family name, so pilgrims often worshiped this stone.
senses.exampleZh: 旧时重男轻女，人们祈求多子以续香火，所以香客常来朝拜这块石头。

senses.zh: n. 儿子们（son的复数）；子弟
senses.enDef: n the divine word of God; the second person in the Trinity (incarnate in Jesus)

senses.zh: adv. 不久, 早, 快, 宁可
senses.enDef: r. in the near future
senses.exampleEn: He named this kind of red-rock land configuration the “Danxia Landform.” The name was soon accepted worldwide.
senses.exampleZh: 他把这种红岩地貌命名为“丹霞地貌”。这个名称很快被全世界接受。

senses.zh: n. 声音, 语音, 吵闹, 声调, 听力范围, 探条, 海峡
senses.enDef: n. the particular auditory effect produced by a given cause
senses.exampleEn: The chickens stand for the present generations; the banana’s big leaves (da ye) sound like “great property” or “great undertaking,” so they suggest the wealth and cause created by past generations.
senses.exampleZh: 鸡群代表今人；芭蕉的“大叶”与“大业”谐音，暗示先辈开创的财富与事业。

senses.zh: a. 健全的, 可靠的, 合理的, 健康的, 彻底的, 资金充实的
senses.enDef: n. the subjective sensation of hearing something

senses.zh: adv. 彻底地, 充分地
senses.enDef: n. mechanical vibrations transmitted by an elastic medium

senses.zh: vi. 发出声音, 回响, 测深, 试探, 听起来
senses.enDef: n. the sudden occurrence of an audible event

senses.zh: vt. 使发声, 宣告, 听诊, 测...深, 试探
senses.enDef: n. the particular auditory effect produced by a given cause

senses.zh: [计] 声音
senses.enDef: n. the particular auditory effect produced by a given cause

senses.zh: n. 南方, 南
senses.enDef: n. the region of the United States lying to the south of the Mason-Dixon line
senses.exampleEn: In the family of Lingnan buildings, it stands among the great ritual / institutional landmarks — alongside places like the Temple of the South China Sea God and Foshan Ancestral Temple — while Kaiping’s watchtowers represent world-heritage vernacular fortresses.
senses.exampleZh: 在岭南建筑大家族里，它与南海神庙、佛山祖庙等并列，属于重要的礼制建筑；而开平碉楼则代表世界遗产级的民间堡垒建筑。

senses.zh: a. 南的, 向南的
senses.enDef: n. the cardinal compass point that is at 180 degrees

senses.zh: adv. 在南方
senses.enDef: n. a location in the southern part of a country, region, or city

senses.zh: vi. 转向南方
senses.enDef: n. the direction corresponding to the southward cardinal compass point

senses.zh: n. 南方人, 男风
senses.enDef: a. in or characteristic of a region of the United States south of (approximately) the Mason-Dixon line
senses.exampleEn: At the tops of the balusters are carved southern fruits: peach, star-fruit (carambola), papaya, lychee, and so on — symbolic sacrificial offerings of the choicest Lingnan fruits to the Chen ancestors.
senses.exampleZh: 栏杆顶端雕着南方水果：桃、杨桃、木瓜、荔枝等——象征把最精美的岭南佳果献给陈氏祖先。

senses.zh: a. 向南方的, 来自南方的
senses.enDef: a. situated in or coming from regions of the south

senses.zh: n. 君主( sovereign的复数形式 ); 国王; 女王; 旧时价值为一镑的英国金币
senses.enDef: n. a nation's ruler or head of state usually by hereditary right
senses.exampleEn: Burying the living with dead sovereigns had prevailed in Central China in the Shang and Zhou dynasties (1766–770 BC), but was largely abolished in the Han Dynasty (206 BC–AD 220).
senses.exampleZh: 活人殉葬在商周时期（公元前一七六六至七七〇年）曾盛行于中原，到汉代（公元前二〇六至公元二二〇年）已基本废除。

senses.zh: n. 位置, 空间, 距离, 太空, 空白, 间隔, (期刊等的)篇幅
senses.enDef: n. the unlimited expanse in which everything is located
senses.exampleEn: The hall is an octagonal, palace-like reinforced concrete structure, 58 meters high, with about 12,000 square meters of floor space.
senses.exampleZh: 纪念堂是一座八角形、宫殿式钢筋混凝土建筑，高五十八米，建筑面积约一万二千平方米。

senses.zh: vt. 隔开, 分隔
senses.enDef: n. an empty area (usually bounded in some way between things)

senses.zh: vi. 留间隔
senses.enDef: n. an area reserved for some particular purpose

senses.zh: [计] 空白, 空格校验
senses.enDef: n. a blank character used to separate successive words in writing or printing

senses.zh: a. 广大的, 宽广的
senses.enDef: s very large in expanse or scope
senses.exampleEn: Fangshi Denglou, built in 1920 by the Fang family, is the most typical watchtower: open land, spacious views, and a full defense kit — electric generator, searchlights, and guns.
senses.exampleZh: 方氏灯楼 Fangshi Denglou 由方氏家族建于一九二〇年，是最典型的更楼：地势开阔、视野宽广，防卫设备齐全——发电机、探照灯和枪支。

senses.zh: a. 广大的, 宽广的
senses.enDef: s (of buildings and rooms) having ample space

senses.zh: vi. 说, 说话, 演说, 发言
senses.enDef: v. use language
senses.exampleEn: Two thousand years under Elephant Hill still speak through jade, bronze, and gold.
senses.exampleZh: 象岗山下两千年的岁月，仍通过玉、青铜和黄金在诉说。

senses.zh: vt. 说, 讲, 说出
senses.enDef: v. make a characteristic or natural sound

senses.zh: n. 专辑, 专车, 号外, 特别的东西, 负有特别任务的人员
senses.enDef: n. a special offering (usually temporary and at a reduced price) that is featured in advertising
senses.exampleEn: This place served as a shrine for sacrifices to the common ancestors of the Chen families; as a venue for clannish activities on festive and other special occasions; and as a school for Chen children — hence “Chen Clan Academy.”
senses.exampleZh: 这里既是陈姓各房祭祀共同祖先的祠堂，也是节庆等特殊场合举行宗族活动的场所，还是陈氏子弟读书的学堂——所以叫“陈氏书院”。

senses.zh: a. 特别的, 专门的, 特殊的, 额外的, 附加的, 特别亲密的
senses.enDef: n. a dish or meal given prominence in e.g. a restaurant

senses.zh: n. 专辑, 专车, 号外, 特别的东西, 负有特别任务的人员
senses.enDef: n. a television production that features a particular person or work or topic

senses.zh: n. 专辑, 专车, 号外, 特别的东西, 负有特别任务的人员
senses.enDef: s. for a special service or occasion

senses.zh: n. 演讲, 说话, 谈话, 言语, 引语, 民族语言
senses.enDef: n. (language) communication by word of mouth
senses.exampleEn: The acoustics are excellent — no annoying echo — so every speech and performance carries clearly.
senses.exampleZh: 声学效果极佳——没有恼人的回声——所以每次演讲和演出都清晰可闻。

senses.zh: [医] 言语, 语言
senses.enDef: n. something spoken

senses.zh: n. 演讲, 说话, 谈话, 言语, 引语, 民族语言
senses.enDef: n. the exchange of spoken words

senses.zh: n. 污点, 地点, 斑点, 点, 娱乐场所, 处境, 少量
senses.enDef: n. a short section or illustration (as between radio or tv programs or in a magazine) that is often used for advertising
senses.exampleEn: The spot under excavation matched the position of Chang Le Gong in the Han palace at Chang’an — so was this Nanyue’s “Chang Le Gong”?
senses.exampleZh: 发掘位置与汉长安宫中的长乐宫位置相对应——那么这里会是南越的“长乐宫”吗？

senses.zh: a. 当场的, 现场的, 现货买卖的, 现金交易的, 抽样的
senses.enDef: n. a small contrasting part of something

senses.zh: vt. 点缀, 玷污, 认出, 准确定...的位, 用灯光照射
senses.enDef: n. a section of an entertainment that is assigned to a specific performer or performance

senses.zh: vi. 玷污, (从空中)侦察敌方目标
senses.enDef: n. a business establishment for entertainment

senses.zh: n. 春天, 弹簧, 跳跃, 弹性, 活力, 泉, 源泉
senses.enDef: n. the season of growth
senses.exampleEn: It is called “Bian Se Long” — the chameleon — because its color changes with the seasons: light green in spring, dark green in summer, yellowish green in autumn, and brownish yellow in winter.
senses.exampleZh: 它叫“变色龙”——颜色随季节而变：春浅绿、夏深绿、秋黄绿、冬棕黄。

senses.zh: a. 春天的
senses.enDef: n. a metal elastic device that returns to its shape or position when pushed or pulled or pressed

senses.zh: vi. 跳, 弹跳, 涌出, 生长, 裂开, 高耸

senses.zh: vt. 使跳起, 使爆炸, 突然提出
senses.enDef: n. a point at which water issues forth

senses.zh: n. 正方形, 街区, 广场, 平方, 直角尺
senses.enDef: n. (geometry) a plane rectangle with four equal sides and four right angles; a four-sided regular polygon
senses.exampleEn: The mountain covers 319 square kilometers, with over 600 red rock peaks standing out against green woods — like a garden of ruby sculptures.
senses.exampleZh: 这座山占地三百一十九平方公里，六百多座红岩峰峦挺立在绿林之间——像一座红宝石雕塑园。

senses.zh: a. 正方形的, 正直的, 公正的, 平方的, 方正的, 结清的
senses.enDef: n. the product of two equal terms

senses.zh: adv. 成直角地, 对准地
senses.enDef: n. something approximating the shape of a square

senses.zh: vi. 一致, 符合, 结清

senses.enDef: n. (geometry) a plane rectangle with four equal sides and four right angles; a four-sided regular polygon

senses.zh: a. 分期的
senses.enDef: a. written for or performed on the stage
senses.exampleEn: The following spring he returned and staged the first armed uprising against the Qing in Guangzhou, but it failed.
senses.exampleZh: 次年春天他回国，在广州发动第一次反清武装起义，但失败了。

senses.zh: n. 楼梯
senses.enDef: n. a flight of stairs or a flight of steps
senses.exampleEn: From roof to floor, inside and out — columns, eaves, ridges, stairs, doors and windows — you will find stone carvings, brick carvings, lime sculptures, ceramic figurines, wood carvings, and iron-cast artistic pieces.
senses.exampleZh: 从屋顶到地面，里里外外——柱、檐、脊、阶、门窗——都能见到石雕、砖雕、灰塑、陶塑、木雕和铸铁艺术品。

senses.zh: n. 茎, 追踪, 高视阔步
senses.enDef: n. a slender or elongated structure that supports a plant or fungus or a plant part or plant organ
senses.exampleEn: Motifs carry meaning: the peony for richness and wealth, twin lotus flowers on one stalk for an affectionate couple, and the lion for power and dignity.
senses.exampleZh: 图案都有寓意：牡丹象征富贵，并蒂莲象征恩爱夫妻，狮子象征威严与权势。

senses.zh: vi. 悄悄靠近, 蹑手蹑脚地走近, 蔓延, 高视阔步
senses.enDef: n. a hunt for game carried on by following it stealthily or waiting in ambush

senses.zh: vt. 追踪, 搜索
senses.enDef: n. the act of following prey stealthily

senses.zh: n. 茎, 追踪, 高视阔步

senses.zh: vt. 忍受, 使站立, 抵挡

senses.exampleZh: 在岭南建筑大家族里，它与南海神庙、佛山祖庙等并列，属于重要的礼制建筑；而开平碉楼则代表世界遗产级的民间堡垒建筑。

senses.zh: n. 惊起, 出发, 开端, 起点, 吃惊, 有利条件
senses.enDef: n. the beginning of anything
senses.exampleEn: At the start of the Western Han, the former Qin general Zhao Tuo founded the Nanyue Kingdom, promoting Han–Yue fusion.
senses.exampleZh: 西汉初年，原秦将赵佗 Zhao Tuo 建立南越国，推行汉越融合。

senses.zh: vi. 开始, 出发, 启动, 跳起, 吃惊, 出现, 松动, 脱落, 起价, 参赛
senses.enDef: n. a turn to be a starter (in a game at the beginning)

senses.zh: [计] 起始
senses.enDef: n. the advantage gained by beginning early (as in a race)

senses.exampleZh: 一九九五年，国务院批准它为地质自然保护区。

senses.exampleZh: 墓中出土九枚印章，其中三枚发现于主棺室赵眜身上，分别刻有“赵眜”、“太子”和“帝印”。

senses.exampleEn: In Zili Village, Mingshilou is the best of all.

senses.enDef: Temple built in 1662 (Kangxi year 1); one of northern Guangdong’s great monasteries.

senses.exampleZh: 最后是别传寺，建于一六六二年，也就是康熙元年。

senses.enDef: Nickname for Danxia Mountain: hundreds of red peaks like ruby sculptures.
senses.exampleEn: That is why it is also called China Ruby Park, or China Red Stone Park.
senses.exampleZh: 所以它又被称为中国红石公园，或中国红宝石公园 China Ruby Park。

senses.zh: 丹霞地貌
senses.enDef: Red sandstone landform with sheer cliffs, named by Chen Guoda in the 1930s.
senses.exampleEn: He named this kind of red-rock land configuration the “Danxia Landform.” The name was soon accepted worldwide.
senses.exampleZh: 他把这种红岩地貌命名为“丹霞地貌”。这个名称很快被全世界接受。

senses.zh: 丹霞山（韶关）
senses.enDef: A famous red-stone mountain in Guangdong; namesake of Danxia landform.
senses.exampleEn: Today we visit Danxia Mountain, about forty-five kilometers northeast of Shaoguan City — a world-famous red-stone landscape and the namesake of a whole geological term.
senses.exampleZh: 今天我们游览丹霞山，它位于韶关市东北约四十五公里处——这里是世界著名的红石景观，也是一种地质术语的命名地。

senses.zh: 群象过江
senses.enDef: Rock formation along Jinjiang River resembling elephants wading.
senses.exampleEn: So this sight is named “The Elephants Crossing the River.”
senses.exampleZh: 所以这处景观叫作“群象过江” The Elephants Crossing the River。

senses.zh: 方氏灯楼
senses.enDef: Typical watchtower (1920) with generator, searchlights, and guns.
senses.exampleEn: Fangshi Denglou, built in 1920 by the Fang family, is the most typical watchtower: open land, spacious views, and a full defense kit — electric generator, searchlights, and guns.
senses.exampleZh: 方氏灯楼 Fangshi Denglou 由方氏家族建于一九二〇年，是最典型的更楼：地势开阔、视野宽广，防卫设备齐全——发电机、探照灯和枪支。

senses.zh: 句鑃
senses.enDef: Set of eight bronze chimes from Nanyue (129 BC); still playable after 2,100+ years.
senses.exampleEn: Especially worth mentioning is a chime of bronzes called “Gou Diao”: eight pieces, cast with the epigraph “Made in the Official Conservatory in the Ninth Year of Emperor Wen,” showing they were made in Nanyue in 129 BC.
senses.exampleZh: 尤其值得一提的是一组青铜乐器“句鑃”Gou Diao：共八件，铸有铭文“文帝九年乐府工造”，说明它们于公元前一二九年在南越制成。

senses.zh: 爵禄封侯
senses.enDef: Homophonic relief: bird, deer, bee, monkey — wishing titles, salary, and nobility.
senses.exampleEn: Please also notice, on the right-hand side behind the stone drum, a relief called “to be conferred a title of nobility” (Jue Lu Feng Hou).
senses.exampleZh: 请再看石鼓右侧后方的浮雕，叫“爵禄封侯” Jue Lu Feng Hou。

senses.zh: 立园
senses.enDef: Chinese–Western villa garden in Tangkou; built 1936 by Xie Weili.
senses.exampleEn: Now we come to Li Garden (Li Yuan), in Beiyi Village, Tangkou Town.
senses.exampleZh: 现在我们来到立园 Li Garden，位于塘口镇北义村。

senses.zh: 吕彦直
senses.enDef: Architect of Sun Yat-sen Memorial Hall; Cornell-trained; died 1929 aged 36.
senses.exampleEn: It was designed by a young Chinese architect, Lu Yanzhi: born in Tianjin, graduated from Tsinghua (Qinghua) University in Beijing, later studied architecture at Cornell University in the USA.
senses.exampleZh: 设计者是年轻的中国建筑师吕彦直 Lu Yanzhi：生于天津，毕业于北京清华大学，后赴美国康奈尔大学学习建筑。

senses.zh: 铭石楼
senses.enDef: Finest residential diaolou in Zili Village; built 1925, five storeys.
senses.exampleEn: In Zili Village, Mingshilou is the best of all.
senses.exampleZh: 在自力村，铭石楼 Mingshilou 是精品中的精品。

senses.zh: 岭南建筑艺术明珠
senses.enDef: Honorific for the Chen Family Temple / Chen Clan Academy.
senses.exampleEn: Today we visit the Chen Family Temple, also called the Chen Clan Academy — the “Pearl of Lingnan Artistic Architecture” in the heart of Guangzhou.
senses.exampleZh: 今天我们参观陈家祠，也称陈氏书院——广州城中心的“岭南建筑艺术明珠”。

senses.zh: 瑞石楼
senses.enDef: Highest and most luxurious Kaiping tower; nine storeys, ~25m.
senses.exampleEn: Ruishilou is the highest and most luxurious tower in Kaiping: nine storeys, about 25 meters high, armored concrete, with elegant traditional Chinese interiors — rated the No. 1 tower in Kaiping.
senses.exampleZh: 瑞石楼 Ruishilou 是开平最高、最豪华的碉楼：九层，高约二十五米，钢筋混凝土结构，内部为中国传统雅致装修——被评为开平第一楼。

senses.zh: 睡美人 / 玉女拦江
senses.enDef: Hill silhouette of a sleeping girl, viewed from Yangyuan Bridge.
senses.exampleEn: This sight is called “The Sleeping Belle,” or “The Beautiful Girl Blocking the River” — Yu Nü Lan Jiang.
senses.exampleZh: 这处景观叫“睡美人” The Sleeping Belle，也叫“玉女拦江” Yu Nü Lan Jiang。

senses.zh: 同盟会
senses.enDef: China Revolutionary League (1905); later the Nationalist Party / Guomintang.
senses.exampleEn: In 1905 in Japan, he founded China’s first political party, the China Revolutionary League (Tong Meng Hui), later the Nationalist Party (Guomintang).
senses.exampleZh: 一九〇五年在日本，他创立了中国第一个政党——中国同盟会 Tong Meng Hui，后来发展为国民党 Guomintang。

senses.zh: 兴中会
senses.enDef: Society for the Revival of China; founded by Sun Yat-sen in Honolulu, 1894.
senses.exampleEn: In 1894 in Honolulu, he founded the first Chinese bourgeois revolutionary organization — the Society for the Revival of China (Xing Zhong Hui).
senses.exampleZh: 一八九四年，他在檀香山创立了中国第一个资产阶级革命团体——兴中会 Xing Zhong Hui。

senses.zh: 修身立本
senses.enDef: “Cultivating moral character is the foundation of success” — Li Garden motto.
senses.exampleEn: The American Chinese owner Xie Weili took the name from his own name, and it expresses the idiom Xiu Shen Li Ben — “cultivating one’s moral character is the foundation of success” — written on an archway in the garden.
senses.exampleZh: 美籍华人园主谢维立取自自己的名字，也寄托着园中牌坊所写的“修身立本”——培养品德是成功的根本。

senses.zh: 阳元石
senses.enDef: Famous phallic stone column on Yangyuan Hill (~28m high, ~7m diameter).
senses.exampleEn: Next is Yangyuan Hill, meaning “the Hill of Male Sex.” The famous stone column here — Yangyuan Stone — is about 28 meters high and 7 meters in diameter, and it looks strikingly like the male organ.
senses.exampleZh: 下一站是阳元山，意思是“男性之山”。这里著名的石柱——阳元石——高约二十八米，直径约七米，外形酷似男性生殖器。

senses.zh: 阴元石
senses.enDef: Cliff formation paired with Yangyuan; nature’s “Adam and Eve” motif.
senses.exampleEn: Nearby is Yinyuan Cliff, formed some one hundred thousand years ago.
senses.exampleZh: 附近是阴元石景区，大约形成于十万年前。

senses.zh: 赵眜（文帝）
senses.enDef: Second king of Nanyue; styled himself Emperor Wen; reigned 137–122 BC.
senses.exampleEn: The tomb owner was Zhao Mo.
senses.exampleZh: 墓主是赵眜 Zhao Mo。

senses.zh: 赵佗
senses.enDef: Former Qin general who founded the Nanyue Kingdom at the start of Western Han.
senses.exampleEn: At the start of the Western Han, the former Qin general Zhao Tuo founded the Nanyue Kingdom, promoting Han–Yue fusion.
senses.exampleZh: 西汉初年，原秦将赵佗 Zhao Tuo 建立南越国，推行汉越融合。
